sentences.text: The entire genus is known from a single fossil humerus bone.
Kaiika represents one of the oldest known penguin species.
The fossil was discovered in 1998 by Dr. Phillip Maxwell in the Kauru Formation near the Waihao River in New Zealand.
The genus was formally described and named by Ewan Fordyce and Daniel Thomas in 2011.
The only known species of Kaiika is Kaiika maxwelli.
Kaiika was an early penguin that lived in South Canterbury, New Zealand, during the Early Eocene epoch.
Kaiika lived between 56 and 48.9 million years ago during the Ypresian stage.
